name: 55346 · Eden Prairie, MN
findings: ZIP 55346 (Eden Prairie) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55346 (Eden Prairie) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55346 (Eden Prairie) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
